edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner require check.
msg.sender is compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership.
msg.sender selects the sender balance entry inside transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender is used as spender key when consuming allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is written into allowed and forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
The external callee can re-enter and observe/modify allowed state after the approval write.
